name: Tokyo Kiraboshi Financial Group, Inc.
summary: Tokyo Kiraboshi Financial Group, Inc. provides financial services for small and medium-sized enterprises in Japan. It operates through two segments: Banking and Lease. The Banking segment offers a variety of deposit products, including current, savings, notice, and time deposits, as well as negotiable certificates of deposit. It provides lending services such as commercial loans, housing loans, and consumer loans; conducts securities investment and trading; and offers domestic and foreign exchange services, trust business, and credit guarantee services.
